lines: Leaving the dangerous-looking streak of light in its wake, the mecha's scythe swiped at us again and again.
『Not when I'm on a roll now! Trampling everyone with overwhelming power is fun! Run for your lives, you fools!』
(Being hunted down by this ridiculous thing... now I've seen it all!)
I picked up an iron pipe that had been lying around, took aim at Lilim-Muo's stomach, and swung at full power.
But its body was harder than I had imagined, and my hands went numb to the bone.
This thing's got some serious armor! It's on par with the UFS's powered exoskeletons... or maybe even better than them...
(Who the hell is this "friend" of hers who could build something like this!?)
Metier, can't you do anything about that thing?
Even if you ask me that... I'm not very good at physical combat. Especially against machines.
If this continued, forget about capturing Lilim, our lives were going to be in danger.
(Damn it... Guess I have no choice...)
There was only thing that would quiet her down.
I shoved my hand in my pocket and pulled out my meager allowance.
(Damn it, how humiliating!! And I just got this month's portion too...)
I shakily pulled out several bills and held them out toward Lilim-Muo.
『Oho, looks like you've started to understand what makes the world go round.』
Seeming satisfied, Lilim-Muo did a little loop-de-loop in mid-air and came to a stop.
Fuma, get out of the way!!
I jumped away from Lilim-Muo upon hearing the familiar voice.
A large lightning ball suddenly appeared and hit Lilim-Muo directly in the head.
Phew... Nice shot if I say so myself!
Perfectly dressed in your Taima-Suit and your Lightning Blasters equipped?
Th-These are... in case you tried anything funny!
If I left Fuma the perv alone with a succubus, who knows what nasty things you might do!
In the event you did happen to try anything, I wanted to be ready to scorch you immediately, so I had them at the ready!
Huh!? Even if she's a succubus, she's still a client!! Who would do anything weird!?
I don't know! This is you we're talking about, Fuma!
As we continued our fruitless quarrel, Metier whispered quietly into my ear from behind.
That's not it, Fuma-san. I'm sure Yukikaze-san is jealous.
Ehehe, I can tell. I am a succubus, you know♪
Upon noticing a charred stench I turned around, and there I saw Lilim tumble out of the sputtering and smoking Lilim-Muo.
Metier then promptly managed to capture her.
Lilim! You're under arrest. You'd better reflect on your actions this time.
Ugh... I guess this is it... uargh...
Thank you so much for all your help.
Thanks to your thorough understanding of Lilim's powers, Fuma-san, we were able to safely capture her despite her falling far short of our expectations.
Pulling the tightly bound Lilim behind her, Metier bowed her head deeply.
Don't ever let her run loose again.
Of course not. ーAh, and also...
All of a sudden, Metier brought her face close to my ear.
I will definitely make sure to repay this favor another time...♪
She suddenly whispered sexily, to which I could only reply with a soft whisper of my own.
(You might not think so looking at her, but she's still a succubus after all...)
Stupid Fuma!! I won't forget this!
Well, I will. So farewell Lilim, and never show your face around here again～
Anyway, that settled it. Without a worry in my mind, I watched the two of them leave and then spun on my heel to go the opposite way.
Now you owe me again, Fuma.
You're right, thanks... Wait, when did you change?
A Taima-Suit stands out in the middle of the city, don't you think?
If you just avoid the busy streets and go straight home then... Hey?!
Before I realized it, Yukikaze had a firm grasp on my arm.
Aahhh... I'm so hungry after shooting up a storm～♪
Sheesh... I guess we're doing this then. What do you want to eat?
Huh!? I don't have that kind of money!!
Relax, I'm just messing! I'm fine with a burger from Nicky B's♪
Yukikaze grinned as she pulled on my arm.
(Sheesh... it's not just succubi who know how to throw a man's heart into turmoil.)
I tightly gripped the allowance in my pocket that Yukikaze had helped to protect.
The storm had passed, quiet had returned to the construction site, and a lone figure appeared.
It rushed over to the wreckage of Lilim-Muo and huddled down, looking heartbroken.
Ahhhh... my work of art is in such a state...
Oh well, it was only a prototype. Next time, I will create something so perfect that it can even withstand the lightning strike from a Taimanin.
The figure gathered the scorched Lilim-Muo parts and left the scene as silently as they came.
